_comment: Narration for the AI voice, one entry per scene (VIDEO_PLAN.md section 13). {caption|voice} gives the voice a different spelling from the captions. {{NAME}} is filled from public/data.json numbers. Scenes 1 and 6 have no narration: our own voices are in the footage.
s2: A recorded motion only works if the brick is always in the same place. Here nothing is fixed, and there are no coordinates in our code. Picking and placing are learned.
s3: The policy is {SmolVLA|Smol V L A}, a vision-language-action model. Camera images, joint positions and a task sentence go in; joint actions come out. It's fine-tuned on {{EPISODES}} teleoperated episodes.
s4: Inspection is the one scripted step. A fixed pose and three wrist angles mean the anomaly model sees every brick the same way. {Anomalib's|Anomah-libs} {PatchCore,|Patch Core,} trained only on good bricks, scores each view.
s5: The verdict becomes the {VLA's|V L A's} next task sentence. The model then finds the plate of that colour, wherever it is.
s7: Across {{R}} random layouts and {{M}} cycles: {{P}} picks worked on the first try, the inspection was right {{I}} times, the policy put {{S}} bricks on the plate it was told, and {{E}} were right end to end.
s7_draft: The evaluation results go here, once the random rounds are done.
s8: All inference runs on the laptop with {OpenVINO.|Open Veeno.} {SmolVLA|Smol V L A} takes {{SORT_MS}} milliseconds per chunk on the GPU; {PatchCore,|Patch Core,} {{INSPECT_MS}} per view.
